sessions.title: Back off sync retries
sessions.prompt: Uploads hammer the records API while it's down. Make the sync client back off with jitter, and stop retrying 4xx responses.

updates.text: Retry sleeps a fixed 500ms and retries every error, so a 400 is sent five times. Capped exponential backoff with full jitter spreads the tablets out, and 4xx should fail at once.

result.text: The file internal/sync/retry.go has been updated.

input.name: review-retry
input.title: Review retry backoff
input.message: Review the retry change in internal/sync/retry.go. Check the jitter bounds, the cap at Max, and that ErrPermanent stops retrying.

turns.reply:
Retries now back off exponentially with full jitter, capped at 10 s, and a 4xx response returns `ErrPermanent` without retrying.

```go
func (p Policy) backoff(attempt int) time.Duration {
	bound := min(p.Base<<attempt, p.Max)
	return rand.N(bound) + 1
}
```

A DeepSeek session is reviewing the change before I add tests.

updates.text: The review found no problems. Sonnet can write the table tests while I run the suite.

input.name: retry-tests
input.title: Test retry backoff
input.message: Write table tests in internal/sync/retry_test.go for Policy.backoff's bounds and for Retry giving up after Attempts.

updates.text: Review passed. A Sonnet session is writing the backoff tests; running the suite meanwhile.

children.name: review-retry
children.title: Review retry backoff
children.message: Review the retry change in internal/sync/retry.go. Check the jitter bounds, the cap at Max, and that ErrPermanent stops retrying.

updates.text: Check that the jitter stays above zero and below the cap, and that permanent errors skip the sleep.

turns.reply: Looks correct. `rand.N(bound) + 1` keeps each delay in (0, bound], `min` holds the cap at `Max`, and `ErrPermanent` returns before the sleep. `Base<<attempt` would overflow past 40 attempts, but `DefaultPolicy` makes five.

sessions.prompt: Muted text in harbor-dark fails WCAG AA on the panel background. Raise its contrast and rebuild the theme.

updates.text: --text-muted on --panel is about 3.9:1. AA needs 4.5:1 for body text.

sessions.title: Document theme tokens
sessions.prompt: List the color tokens in src/tokens.css and what each one is for.

turns.reply: `--surface` and `--panel` are the page and panel backgrounds, `--text` and `--text-muted` the body and secondary text, `--accent` links and focus rings, and `--danger` errors.
Three decisions: ship offline sync before the December survey, move theme tokens into a shared package, and retire the CSV export once the records API is stable.
